newsitems.title: Space Beach Party 2026 - Preview
newsitems.author: Snifle
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/2a457704bc6877b0db889fb959c3904c95f327d6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Hello Miners,[/h1][p]Those of you who are fresh back from the Magma Core might not notice, but summer is here, and it brought the heat. It also means the annual Space Beach Party is just around the corner! So we’re here to take a quick peek at what’s coming.
[/p][p]This year’s event starts on Thursday, August 6th at 13.00 CEST and runs for two weeks.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/06484430953359e28f0d2da2fad0e7bcb8e80d3f.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Because one can never have too many inflatables[/b][/h3][p]Why get extra vacation days for your hard work when you can get hats, you ask? We hear you. That’s why you can get your hands on the new [b]Tactical Turtle[/b] hat by completing the assignment associated with this year's Space Beach Party from the Mission Terminal. Nicknamed Shelly the Shellmet, we’re sure this sturdy companion will help protect you from Glyphid bites.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/aa5de54186225e22c8c37080d0c750a728c85741.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Season event and Double XP[/b][/h3][p]While DRG manages to pull off year-after-year performance improvements, the same cannot be said about certain other companies. In a show of unfounded trust, DRG has once again tasked Longbeard Freight with providing you with some well-deserved pool floaties. Unfortunately, the unthinkable has happened. They fumbled the load.[/p][p][/p][p]Somehow, the trajectory of this year’s delivery of pool floaties missed the docking entrance and bounced onwards towards Hoxxes. If you want your floaties, you’ll have to go get them yourselves. Longbeard Freight blames the recently-attached Resinite Mass containers blocking the entrance to the Space Rig’s loading dock. DRG blames Longbeard Freight for inebriated pilots. Both parties signed an agreement, agreeing to disagree on the matter.[/p][p][/p][p]Locate the lost pool floaties and make sure to deposit them while down there. As a sign of gratitude, Management will reward you and your team with a [b]Double Performance Pass Point Bonus[/b].[/p][h3]
[b]Hats have no expiration date[/b][/h3][p]For those of you too busy mining Morkite to fly more kites during our previous years’ celebrations, fret not. Management applauds your focus and drive as long as it remains profitable. Complete one work assignment, and you will be rewarded with [b]all the previous Beach Party hats[/b] for your collection.
[/p][h3][b]Bringing the vibes so that you don’t have to[/b][/h3][p]No party without decorations. Directly imported from Sandblasted Corridors, Management is thrilled to showcase a cost-friendly alternative to sunny beaches on the Space Rig. Colorful lanterns, fake palms, and beach inflatables have been dusted off and can once again be found in the Space Rig, all there to give you a nice feeling of vacation while being at work.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/964b81b9d43e7c447723aab10306a6820316ac6f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]That about wraps it up. [/p][p]See you all on [b]August 6th at 13:00 CEST[/b] for the 2026 Space Beach Party! [/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][h2]New DRG merch coming via Heroic Replicas![/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="zwhdJRkt1-c;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Oh, and another quick announcement: There’s another collection of DRG merch on the way, courtesy of Dave at Heroic Replicas!

He’s been hard at work cooking up some new products, including some of the most-requested items from fans. There will be stuff like:[/p][list][*][p] A re-issue of the DRG soundtrack on vinyl (and the Rogue Core OST too!)[/p][/*][*][p]New t-shirts and crispy fresh DRG underwear[/p][/*][*][p]A full-metal 16-pound pickaxe for the mightiest miners[/p][/*][/list][p]You can check out the full collection in the video above — and [url="https://www.launchoracle.com/heroic-replicas/deep-rock-galactic/EM5E7"][u]click here to get notified when the Kickstarter goes live[/u][/url] next week. Rock and Stone![/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]Warm embraces from[/p][list][*][p]Invisible Walls & The Ghost Ship Crew[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Special Event: Do your part to support Operation Rogue Core!
newsitems.author: GSG_Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/c960f58e524691f3ebef3e53d60c3ad0c603d4b5.png[/img]
[h1]Hello Miners,[/h1]

We’ve got a critical situation on our hands.

An enormous electromagnetic pulse has just erupted at the core of Hoxxes IV, sending ripples throughout the entire planet. It’s brought all our deep-level Expenite extraction operations offline — we’ve lost contact entirely. If that wasn’t bad enough, we’re seeing a spike in Core Stone encounters, and the lethal Core Spawn that come with them. Emergency Action Protocol ‘Minefall’ is in effect. 

It’s time for Operation [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/][b]ROGUE CORE[/b][/url]. Management has dispatched an elite squad of Reclaimers to the depths of Hoxxes to breach and secure the mine sites that have gone offline. But while the Reclaimers are deployed near the core, we need your help to ensure your own work sites stay operational.

Management is seeking volunteers to assist in the new ‘Reclaimer Collaboration Initiative,’ where mining crews help support our brave Reclaimers in mitigating this crisis. 

This is more than a matter of life and death. Company profits are at stake here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/
[h2]Exclusive Assignment: ‘Operation ROGUE CORE’[/h2]

This is a time-limited special event in celebration of the Early Access launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/]Rogue Core[/url]. It will be live in Deep Rock Galactic starting on [b]Wednesday, May 6th[/b] and it will run for a whole two months, ending on [b]Thursday, July 9th[/b].

[u][b]THE ASSIGNMENT:[/b][/u] Four missions. In each one, you must close Core Rifts to prevent further disruptions in the cave system. These missions will be flagged with the new ‘Core Corruption’ warning, meaning you can expect to encounter increased Core Spawn resistance, even if you don’t come across a Core Stone.

[u][b]THE REWARD:[/b][/u] Completing this entire assignment will unlock all the components for the standard-issue Reclaimer Combat Pickaxe. Some steps of the assignment will reward more than one component. You can mix and match these pickaxe parts with all the rest, of course — or run the complete set to honor our brave Reclaimers deployed further down.

Like we mentioned above, this event is one of our few time-limited assignments — so you'll need to complete it by the time the event ends to snag the striking combat axe of the Company’s finest! 

Even though Rogue Core is only planned for PC Early Access at the moment, this special event will be available on console versions of Deep Rock Galactic as well. It'll go live up to two weeks later, pending console-specific certification processes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/6d19a7a1b9bfdc37ec38a3852a016da936733ec3.png[/img]

[h2]ROGUE CORE: Launching to Early Access on May 20th[/h2]

A lot of you have been following [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/]Rogue Core[/url]’s development for a while, and the release date is almost here — it’s launching to Early Access here on Steam in just two weeks!

If you're just hearing about Rogue Core now, here's what you need to know:
[list]
[*] [b]It's a spinoff of Deep Rock Galactic.[/b] We've expanded the world of DRG into the perspective of the Reclaimers, the Company's elite in-house security force. You'll be able to play as five all-new classes, each with their own special skills and fancy gadgets.
[*] [b]It's faster-paced and more intense.[/b] You'll need to stay on your toes and keep your head on a swivel. Combat is more frequent and the game is tougher — but failing a mission isn't quite the setback as it is in DRG.
[*] [b]It's a co-op roguelike.[/b] Rogue Core explores DRG's 1-4 player co-op gameplay in a roguelike format: this means you'll gather a new set of weapons and upgrades each mission, snowballing into powerful builds and elemental synergies.
[/list]Rogue Core takes place in the same world and timeline as Deep Rock Galactic, but deeper down near the core of Hoxxes IV. You’ll step into the boots of the elite Reclaimers, and fight your way through hordes of Core Spawn abominations in fast-paced special ops missions to secure infested mining facilities.

If you're interested, you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/]check out the store page here[/url].

[previewyoutube=NVycgbZfotE;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/[hr][/hr]
We'll see you down in the mines — and we salute every miner who pitches in and does their part to support our brave Reclaimers in their fight to take back Hoxxes. Rock and Stone, miners!

[i]With love,
-The Ghost Ship Crew[/i]

newsitems.title: 'Eight Years in Orbit' anniversary event preview
newsitems.author: GSG Lars
newsitems.contents:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/120c9e4c03b6d4766a52c757adb1e6b88899d75a.jpg"][/img][/h1][h1]Hello Miners,[/h1][p]
We're nearing Eight Years in Orbit, which means it's time for another mandatory work social!.[/p][p]The past eight years have seen record profits for the Deep Rock Galactic Corporation, thanks in no small part to your hard work in the mines. We can only imagine what the earnings reports will look like years from now, when you’re nearing the end of your standard 30-year contracts. We like to think of this company as a family, and you are our valued, situationally expendable family members.[/p][p]In order to properly applaud and appreciate your efforts, we'll be hosting a Company Party! [/p][p]The '[b]Eight Years in Orbit'[/b] Party is going live next week on [b]Tuesday, March 3rd at 13.00 CET[/b]. We believe you are capable of both intense drinking and intense mining, so we'll keep the celebration going for two entire weeks. Here’s a preview of this year’s anniversary celebration[i]:[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/cdc6a7ac38bdb38f20f5dbe4b2333ed54829f4a7.png"][/img][/p][h3]Exclusive Hat - Limited Availability![/h3][p][i]"To infinity and beyond!"[/i] is what we'd say if the hat was turned sideways. Featuring genuine gold plating and teeny pickaxes, this is the ultimate headwear for any hard-working dwarf looking to showcase their dedication to the Company. A team from R+D’s Future Concepts Division spent the past eight years working on a name for this hat, and they came up with ‘[b]Party Hat - Year Eight[/b]’! You can acquire this beauty by completing the associated assignment. Please note that this is a rare instance of a time-limited exclusive hat, so be sure to get it completed before the event ends. In other words, get to work![/p][p][/p][h3]Double Up on Performance Pass Bonus[/h3][p]The anniversary is making us feel generous (don’t worry, we’ve already booked an appointment with a specialist), so how about a [b]Double Performance Pass Bonus[/b]? If you spot a hidden Year 8 Anniversary Trophy in the caves, dig it out, deposit it and get your bonus! Be aware that you may need to use the scanner to locate it.[i]

newsitems.title: Season 06: 'Relics of Hoxxes' is NOW LIVE!
newsitems.author: GSG_Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/8753193b20ca75670e7f6fd463a180905122d08b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Miners,[/h1]

Welcome to SEASON 06 - RELICS OF HOXXES! New discoveries on Hoxxes require your urgent attention. You’re delving into a brand new planetary region, pursuing new riches, and facing off those who might stand in the Company’s way.

Season 06 is live right this minute here on Steam, and it’ll come to consoles in about two weeks. As always, this small delay is because of console-specific certification processes.

Let’s take a look at the new season!

[u][b]Technical note: Steam's video embedding feature is still uncooperative for some people, it seems. If you don't see a clickable video right below this text, there should be a small hyperlink instead.[/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=isaOditbLPg;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr][h2][b]Patch notes - S06: Relics of Hoxxes[/b][/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/62615169e5ccf5bd2795ab552c702cd79be2bbdb.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]NEW MISSION: HEAVY EXTRACTION[/b][/h3]
The Company has detected a new material that was recently unearthed by a series of planetwide tectonic shifts. Huge deposits of Resinite have been discovered all over Hoxxes.

Delve underground, seek out the Resinite Masses, dig them free, and extract them via the lift rockets we send down to assist in the endeavor. We’ve got no equipment to triangulate the exact location of Resinite Masses, so keep your eyes peeled for great amber chunks sticking out of the ground.

As always, Management recommends familiarizing yourself with the mission details in the Miner’s Manual aboard the Space Rig. Good luck down there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/b8aca8c2d48a9fbb1886dc989388f5fa46b8045d.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/f5fcfd19f695e744154f513e9d1613449e220b25.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]NEW BIOME: OSSUARY DEPTHS[/b][/h3]
A new planetary region has been discovered, and management has approved the [b]Ossuary Depths[/b] for extraction operations. This gloomy new biome is home to a grim collection of skeletal remains gathered from all over Hoxxes.

And among these dusty bones lives a new threat: The Ossirans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/1e69347ad20d02eacdb96f8d1ba7f325cfe118f1.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]THREE NEW ENEMIES[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/3ceb5ff0437a372a52b8a794ffa5af533ae2936d.jpg[/img]
[u][b]OSSIRAN SCRAB:[/b][/u] This winged menace is capable of swarming you from above and below. It’s an agile threat when flying through the air, and its thick outer shell allows it to put up a strong defense when grounded. Your best bet is to deal damage when it's airborne.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/cd770a67b80e6307f93ed3c8384769007c2edc7e.jpg[/img]
[u][b]OSSIRAN PIT JAW:[/b][/u] This larger variant of Ossiran lies in wait just below the surface, ready to ambush any dwarf that wanders too close. Its jaws are strong enough to incapacitate, and it’ll take a good chunk out of your health if it catches you. It may let you go, especially if provided with sufficient incentive from your allies, but be warned - once its cover is blown, the Pit Jaw will relocate to set up another ambush nearby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/d8bbf7dcbe238aea359a50612923e84c12d17e5c.jpg[/img]
[u][b]OSSIRAN BONE COLLECTOR:[/b][/u] Lacking any offensive capabilities, the Bone Collector will flee when confronted by a heavily armed dwarf. Should you encounter it, give it a fright and keep an eye on where it runs off to…

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/faa2bbb3dfa954ccfc28ca9b330c23bc1f2a1cc7.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]SEASON EVENT: OSSIUM RAID[/b][/h3]
Ossiran Bone Collectors have been spotted all over Hoxxes. You’ll know them by their distinct blue glow and scurrying movements (no, it’s not Scout). The Bone Collectors are harmless, and will run off when threatened (wait is it Scout?). Once they do, follow their trail through the caves until you reach their lair. Digging through a thin layer of dirt, you’ll find a secret trove of Ossium gems, a unique and valuable byproduct of the Ossirans’ bone collections.

Be aware: Disturbing the Ossium gems will alert nearby nesting Scrabs, so be careful when raiding these Ossium troves.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/b3dfdeba41fcece7b63b8c68d7abacd609ac172a.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]NEW DEEP DIVE SECONDARY OBJECTIVE: HEAVY EXTRACTION[/b][/h3]
The aforementioned tectonic tremors have caused Resinite Mass deposits to appear throughout the caves of Hoxxes. Now you may encounter them in any biome during Deep Dive operations. In this case, you you know what to do: Find the Resinite Mass, dig it free, and extract it using the provided lift rockets. Then carry on with your main objective.

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]NEW MISSION WARNINGS[/b][/h3]

[u][b]SCRAB NESTING GROUNDS:[/b][/u] Swarms of Scrabs have settled in caves all over Hoxxes. Expect a steady influx of Scrab hostiles, and try to steer clear of their nests.

[u][b]PIT JAW COLONY:[/b][/u] Reports have come in of migratory groups of Pit Jaws spotted both within and beyond the Ossuary Depths. Watch your step on any mission where this warning is active.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/cefc3a6eb1b9a34b370b764a663dc96aa7b2f41e.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]NEW PERFORMANCE PASS[/b][/h3]
Season 06 comes with a brand new Performance Pass loaded with new cosmetics, mineral bundles and an all-new weapon framework, [b]Diesel Driven[/b], to earn through good old hard work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/0b343025fd44d4fc627d0e07f8156ae7f025b6f7.jpg[/img]
As always, the Performance Pass (and all other Season 06 content) is completely free, and you can always switch back to progress in other seasons' Performance Passes whenever you want.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/4eb2fb541c50bedfd0f4201dd65c7b409ce1478c.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]NEW DANCE MOVES[/b][/h3]
We’ve taught the dwarves another 2 new dance moves:
[olist]
[*] Get groovy with [b]The Disco Finger[/b].
[*] Or showcase your elastic appendages with [b]The Arm Wave[/b].
[/olist]Dance moves are to be used responsibly at the Abyss Bar dance floor only.

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]NEW WEAPON MAINTENANCE PAINT JOBS[/b][/h3]
We’re expanding the Weapon Maintenance reward system with a new paint job to earn:
WM 6.1 ‘Crimson Call’. It’s red.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/31ab9875b628423f91f44cdb6aac75437ffb6f47.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]NEW DLC: THE RELIC RAIDER PACK[/b][/h3]
Join the Relic Raiders: Deep Rock Galactic’s daring division of combat archaeologists. If antiquities turn up at a dig site, it’s the Raiders who get sent in to catalog, appraise and extract the goods. They’re a bit old school, sure – but so is their line of work.

Whoever said [i]“It belongs in a museum!”[/i] clearly didn’t know how much this stuff sells for.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4207910/Deep_Rock_Galactic__Relic_Raider_Pack/
This DLC is purely cosmetic, and will not affect your gameplay, performance or progression in any way.

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]MISC.[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added another loadout slot
[*] Fixed Nemesis debris colliding with players.
[*] Fixed Blowthrough Rounds not correctly calculating damage increases from  .
[*] Fixed Disconnection Protection giving players infinite fall damage resistance.
[*] Fixed Proximity Mines not triggering on hidden enemies decloaking inside its range.
[*] Fixed Protein Disruption Mix on Corrosive Sludge Pump applying a permanent slow debuff to targets.
[*] Fixed being unable to break free from ice or Rockpox on console using mouse and keyboard.
[*] Fixed an issue where Resonance Crystals would not be properly detected when digging them free.
[*] Fixed controller bug with giving players possibility to break free from being frozen by using WASD as well as their controller
[*] Space Rig doors open faster now (huge)
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/h3]

In general, all mods can be unstable at a new season release. If you encounter excessive crashes, disable your mods until mod creators have had a chance to update them.

[hr][/hr]

Suit up, boot up and get to work, miners! There's a fortune to be made.

[i]With love,
- The Ghost Ship Crew[/i]

newsitems.title: The Season 06 Narrated Trailer is here!
newsitems.author: GSG_Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/8fa941131dbd462aae3f21bcdd6e7add0ef4fd95.jpg"][/img]

[h1]Hello Miners,[/h1]

Just two weeks until we breach the Ossuary Depths for all the perils and profits of Season 06. “Relics of Hoxxes” goes live on Steam on [b]Thursday, January 29th[/b] (and coming to consoles around two weeks after), bringing a new biome, new mission, new enemies, loads of rewards, and more to the work site.

But don’t just take it from us – here’s Mission Control to walk you through everything in the official Season 06 Narrated Trailer. The full write-up is right down below.

[u][b]Technical note: Steam's video embedding feature is still uncooperative for some people, it seems. If you don't see a clickable video right below this text, there should be a small hyperlink instead.[/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=ISkjtsSYtsA;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Deployment zone: OSSUARY DEPTHS[/b][/h2]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/d7562d6ea5ec9e50b2502b2e5e53525e1b83bc23.jpg"][/img]
[code]“...the striking column formations give these caverns the appearance of a great cathedral, though the bones amassed here might suggest this place is more of a burial catacomb. In light of this possibility, as well as observed hostilities from local fauna, we urge company management to avoid this ‘boneyard’ for any future mining operations.”[/code][p][i]-Excerpt from a report by the DRG Planetary Surveys Department
[/i]
While some mothballed old documents in the company archives make mention of the [b]Ossuary Depths[/b], the fabled “boneyard” was overlooked for many years. Management considered it a recording error, the product of a careless and overly-cautious company surveyor.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/68d3560ef55555a132768f7715cdaac8e61f55c6.gif"][/img]

But thanks to recent Deep Scan operations, we’ve uncovered some blind spots on our planetary profile, and discovered an area that precisely matches these early descriptions of the “Boneyard of Hoxxes.” Except the stuff about it being dangerous or sacred. We looked into that and it’s not true.

So prepare yourselves for deployment: Deep Rock Galactic is preparing all mining teams to initiate extraction in the [b]Ossuary Depths[/b].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/ea603d5f44987cd28c23a0183e5904a39ced7935.gif"][/img]

The Ossuary Depths was once in near-total isolation from the rest of Hoxxes, but our initial scouting operations have opened up enough tunnels that all the usual hostile creatures of Hoxxes have found their way down here. 

You’ll also have to contend with the native species of the Depths: the [b]Ossirans[/b]. 
We’ll get to them a bit later.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/bac6b6915e2a08e9d36b04912e6b3f38ef39fb97.jpg"][/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]New mission: HEAVY EXTRACTION[/b][/h2]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/62d72366fcaf1cbe3733b1dbb492d8fcab3d5088.gif"][/img]

We’re not down here on a sightseeing trip. There’s a new work order on the docket. 

As a result of the tectonic disturbances (allegedly) connected to our Deep Scan operations, priceless clusters of Resinite Mass have been pushed closer toward the surface. R+D reckons these ancient relics may give us deeper insights into Hoxxes IV’s natural history, but failing that, they’re worth a king’s ransom to the right buyer. So we need you to dig ‘em up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/dee88b73f50b005cf2eb05d9ce050aee8c7ab9f8.jpg[/img]
Your first step is to locate and excavate Resinite Mass in your work site. You don’t need any fancy equipment to find them beyond a good old fashioned pair of eyeballs. They ought to glimmer a bit if you look carefully.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/0bd3a7dc96cc0d957dbd85e82031fae15470448c.jpg"][/img]
Once found, it’s time to roll up your sleeves. Use your pickaxes to dig out the surrounding area in order to make space for extraction. If you’ve got a Driller on your team, they'll feel extra special during this part. If you don’t, you’ll wish you did.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/9ad428076f466c3baae0a8c6a35b49fd73f6c6a0.jpg"][/img]
Finally, it’s time for extraction! Mission Control will send down a Lift Pod containing four heavy lift rockets. Fix the rockets to the Resinite Mass, then keep your beards clear of the launch zone as the lasers carve a path upwards for orbital extraction.

It’s a straightforward job, honest work for an honest dwarf. Any injuries related to the lasers fall under the “Laser-Based Maiming Liability Exemptions” section in your contract.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Enemy classification: THE OSSIRANS[/b][/h2]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/6e14d1521ef89b548d526577096c5bec3d97d5f4.jpg"][/img]
During your work down in the Depths, you can expect to be interrupted by the local inhabitants: [b]the Ossirans.[/b] As it turns out, they don’t appreciate the new mining operations we’re conducting in their home.

The Ossirans thrive on collecting the countless bones that give the Ossuary Depths its name. Our files indicate they were once a relatively docile scavenger species, but recent intrusions have stirred them into a frenzy. When you deploy to the Ossuary Depths, you'll need to keep a keen eye peeled for these new threats.

[h2]Ossiran Scrab[/h2]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/3f86211cf6362727aae397ec7175e57ecb350f42.gif"][/img]

[u]THE SCRAB:[/u] These flying scavengers work in swarms, scouring the Ossuary Depths in search of any bit of meat left on the countless bones cluttering the caves. A single Scrab is an annoyance, but a handful of them can spell disaster for a mining team. Their armored wings protect a squishy thorax underneath, so target them when they’re airborne for extra damage. And take care not to disturb their hives – the last dwarf to do so lived just long enough to see what his own skeleton looked like.

[h2]Ossiran Pit Jaw[/h2]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/f46d9ca9611b99f26797c0fc67243c2b739f9619.gif"][/img]

[u]THE PIT JAW:[/u] A larger, deadlier, more patient cousin of the Scrab. It’s a predator with a recently-acquired taste for dwarf. With a massive four-pronged jaw, it burrows into the cave floor, waiting to spring up like a bear trap to catch its prey. If you’re lucky, you might just see the tips of its jaws poking through the dirt before it’s too late. Essentially, it’s a cave leech in the floor. 

Oh, and as if things couldn't get worse: this sneaky rascal has found its way into other biomes of Hoxxes, too. If you come across the new [b]Pit Jaw Colony[/b] Mutator, make sure to watch your step. Good luck!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/bae262ae946c3d5af11009f06c803959cb670617.jpg"][/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Seasonal event: OSSIUM RAID[/b][/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/16fa322ae1692510df09b5e708182edecb79aef8.jpg"][/img]
While the Ossirans pose an undeniable threat to our workforce, they also present a rather significant profit opportunity. As it turns out, they’re able to convert bone mass into crystalline [b]Ossium[/b], which is quite valuable thanks to its myriad applications in munitions and cosmetics manufacturing.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/8659dd5380547703206bc66c6637da31ff559981.jpg"][/img]
To collect Ossium, you’ll first need to find an Ossiran Bone Collector. This insectoid prospector serves as the warden of local caches of Ossium, and you’ll find it roving the caves of Hoxxes. It’s likely to flee if attacked – but if you follow it, it’ll lead you straight to a rich cache of Ossium.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/6073e3144f8bb41e7bf5fe1c3a69a47df09588a9.jpg"][/img]
Track it down by the telltale trail of Ossium shards and navigate through its labyrinthian tunnels, and you’ll arrive at its lair. From there, grab as much Ossium as you can and get it deposited in the M.U.L.E. for extraction. You might be wise to expect resistance, however. The Ossirans seem to be quite protective about their Ossium.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/b99ec9c542eeb4736d53c5625da7411bdf6db952.jpg"][/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]New S06 Performance Pass[/b][/h2]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/1785aa88341ce23ac7c7c54bc8608be681028306.jpg"][/img]
An intriguing new internal study from R+D found that higher wages are directly correlated with increased worker performance. Unfortunately, higher wages are also directly correlated with increased payroll costs, so Management has decided to give you hats instead.

To incentivize all employees during the many exciting work opportunities of Season 06, we’re rolling out a brand new Performance Pass! Working your way through this new Performance Pass will unlock loads of shiny goodies, not least of which is the all-new [b]Diesel Driven[/b] weapon framework. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/8f65231b0e73c7ebf6a133d8ab297cc4f850da31.jpg"][/img]
The Season 06 Performance Pass and associated Progression Track are full of other cool goodies too. You'll be able to earn:
[list]
[*] A dozen new hats
[*] Flashy new facial hairs
[*] New weapon paintjobs
[*] New armor paintjobs
[*] A new pickaxe set
[*] An additional framework for our loyal friend Bosco
[*] A couple new end-screen animations
[*] And more!
[/list]Speaking of impressive performance, we’ve also added a new unlockable tier to the Weapon Maintenance system so you can properly show off your prowess. ‘WM6 CRIMSON CALL’ is soon available for all high-performing employees.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/019cc0bcffc2a5e988296b4ef01f3ecb8dd989d8.jpg"][/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Fresh new moves for the dance floor[/b][/h2]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/534bf2ac431b0c7257d89505e61862edb41770c6.gif"][/img]

In their spare moments of free time, the dwarves have been very busy learning a couple cool new dance moves. They’re very excited to hit the floor and show them off. Gunner says he wishes he’d studied contemporary dance in school, but it’s far too late for that. Back to the mines, Gunner.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]New DLC: the RELIC RAIDERS Pack[/b][/h2]

If you’re tromping through lost catacombs in search of treasure, you may as well look the part. That’s why we’re rolling out the all-new (or all-old?) Relic Raider DLC pack, to give your dwarves some seasoned vintage style down in the Ossuary Depths.

The Relic Raiders are Deep Rock Galactic’s daring division of combat archaeologists. If antiquities turn up at a dig site, it’s the Raiders who get sent in to catalog, appraise and extract the goods. They’re a bit old school, sure. But so is their line of work. Whoever said [i]“It belongs in a museum!”[/i] clearly didn’t know how much this stuff sells for.

[previewyoutube="n8LG8V0hnws;full"][/previewyoutube]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4207910/Deep_Rock_Galactic__Relic_Raider_Pack/"][/dynamiclink]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Experimental Branch is now live[/b][/h2]

If you’d like to help playtest Season 06 as we prepare for the full release, you can already get your hands on it via the Experimental Branch, which goes live today. It’s experimental for a reason, of course, so you might expect a couple hiccups.

Here’s how to access the Experimental Branch:
[list]
[*] In your Steam library, right-click on ‘Deep Rock Galactic’, then select ‘Properties.’
[*] Go to the ‘Betas’ tab and select the one called “experimental - Latest dev build - enter at own risk”.
[*] Steam will then update your game, and when you launch Deep Rock Galactic it will be in this Experimental mode. To switch back, select the “Default” branch under ‘Betas’.
[/list]You can find more information in the [url="https://discord.com/invite/drg"]DRG Discord[/url] about bug reporting, discussions and changelogs for the Experimental Branch. Keep in mind that your progress [i][u]will not[/u][/i] be saved in the Experimental Branch, and this branch will only be open for a limited time.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Some QoL and bugfixes[/b][/h2]
Season 06 will also come with some minor QoL improvements and the usual bucket of bugfixes, but we’ll post these in the patch notes when it all goes live. Stay tuned.

[hr][/hr]
That’s it! Check your equipment, limber up, and get ready to venture back into the depths on [b]January 29th[/b] when SEASON 06: RELICS OF HOXXES comes to a computer near you. 

Rock and Stone!

[i]With love,
-The Ghost Ship Crew[/i]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Season 06: “Relics of Hoxxes” is coming to Steam on January 29th
newsitems.author: GSG_Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/2a4ea34b8c4f606cc25b54aad66cff756e46194e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Miners,[/h1]

We hope everyone’s having a mineral-rich start to 2026. What a number! And you know what else ends in 6? Season 06. Speaking of which, we’ve got news. 

We’re here to share the official Season 06 key art and reveal the release date, though some of you keen-eyed miners already figured it out from the cluess we teased earlier this week. Congratulations! And now, drum roll:

Season 06: RELICS OF HOXXES is coming to Steam in just a few weeks, on [b]January 29th, 2026[/b]. It’ll hit consoles about 2 weeks after that.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/204cf0cc0d7e55ee05d2119020de7753c2392a29.jpg[/img]

In Season 06, we’re digging into the ancient past, down among the dusty bones of the new [b]Ossuary Depths[/b] biome. 

But we’re not going down in this gloomy old sepulchre for some memento mori nonsense – we’re here to get rich. Well, to make the Company rich. Same thing. The new [b]Heavy Excavation[/b] mission puts you in pursuit of priceless Resinite Mass deposits, which we’ll need dug up and sent spacewards as fast as you can muster. But keep your guns close at hand: in addition to the usual swarms of Glyphids, you’ll be going toe-to-toe with the [b]Ossiran[/b] enemies and their nasty new tricks.

More details on all that coming next week. Just mark your calendars for now, because Management expects all employees fresh-faced and eager to work on January 29th.


[h2]New DLC: The 'Relic Raider' Pack[/h2]

Of course, if you’re tromping through lost catacombs in search of treasure, you’d be a fool not to look the part. That’s why we’re rolling out the all-new (or all-old?) [b]Relic Raider DLC[/b] pack, to give your dwarves some seasoned vintage style down in the Ossuary Depths.

The Relic Raiders are Deep Rock Galactic’s daring division of combat archaeologists. If antiquities turn up at a dig site, it’s the Raiders who get sent in to catalog, appraise and extract the goods. They’re a bit old school, sure. But so is their line of work. Whoever said [i]“It belongs in a museum!”[/i] clearly didn’t know how much this stuff sells for.

[previewyoutube=n8LG8V0hnws;full][/previewyoutube]
The Relic Raider Pack will go live along with Season 06 on January 29th, but you can already wishlist it right here on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4207910/Deep_Rock_Galactic__Relic_Raider_Pack/
[hr][/hr]
That’s all for now! More to come in the following weeks, so keep an eye on your news feed for updates and details.

Much love and a big ol’ [b]Rock and Stone[/b] to you all. Talk soon!

With love,
-The Ghost Ship Crew

newsitems.title: DRG Season 06 confirmed – and it’s coming in a few months
newsitems.author: GSG_Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/953208e5e7e1e8be1282c955ec9dcc113a9e1cca.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Miners,[/h1]

We just wrapped up another On the Horizon livestream to make some big announcements about Deep Rock Galactic and Rogue Core! And we're putting this article out to give you a tidy summary of everything we covered.

Here are the three big headlines:
[olist]
[*][b]Deep Rock Galactic Season 06 is coming.[/b] Sooner than you’d think, too. We’re aiming for a release in Q1 of 2026.
[*][b]Rogue Core’s Early Access release is pushed to Q2 2026.[/b] We need more time to make it the game we want it to be. It’ll come out after DRG Season 06.
[*][b]Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is now out on mobile.[/b] It just launched yesterday on Google Play and Apple’s App Store.
[/olist]You can [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/4XE7nCb2wCM?si=weI99rlEvk9UnJbW]watch the whole broadcast here[/url], or check out just the section focused on Deep Rock Galactic right in the video below. Then we'll get into all the details.

[previewyoutube=tjXPKV1BCTw;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Deep Rock Galactic: Season 06 is coming soon.[/b][/h2]
For a while now we’ve said that we won’t be looking at Season 06 until we get Rogue Core out in Early Access. That wasn’t exactly true. We [i]have[/i] been looking into it – we just didn’t want to make any announcements until we knew for sure we were running with it. 

Season 06 is confirmed, and it’s coming [i]before[/i] Rogue Core's early access launch (more on that later). We’re currently aiming for a S06 release date in Q1 2026.

The reason we’re now able to work on Deep Rock Galactic and Rogue Core at the same time is because we’ve brought in reinforcements from our neighboring Danish developers, Invisible Walls.

We’ve wanted Season 06 as much as anyone, but we kept having to face the fact that we simply don’t have enough people at Ghost Ship Games to work on Deep Rock Galactic and Rogue Core at the same time. We tried it and it was clunky and stressful. If we wanted to have our cake and eat it too, we’d either need to interview, hire and train 10-15 more employees… or we could ask for help from our friends.

Bringing in Invisible Walls was the natural choice for us. They’re people we know and trust, they’ve played loads of DRG, their office is a 15-minute walk from ours, and we feel like we’re aligned on what makes a good game and a nice working experience. All that makes it easy for us to work together. They’ve been talking with our programmers, game designers and artists for the past half year to learn the arcane ways of DRG’s code, and they’re taking on most of the work for this upcoming season, with direction from GSG’s Game Director Mikkel and Lead Game Designer Mike.

And it goes without saying that we’re very impressed with their work so far. So let’s take a closer look and see what’s coming in [b]Season 06: RELICS OF HOXXES[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/277b25083695ff78c6678da65b3cbc51f0b00d6a.png[/img]

[i][u][b]PLEASE NOTE:[/b] Everything you see below is still a work in progress. Final appearances, features and functionality can (and will) change before release.[/u][/i]


[h3][b]NEW BIOME: Ossuary Depths[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/489ab17a7266c32f953c4b67c4311e028e84251b.png[/img]
Some mothballed documents in the Planetary Surveys Archive make mention of a “Boneyard of Hoxxes,” but Management has always dismissed it as an early surveyor’s error. Speculation on this topic has been discouraged.

But recent Deep Scan operations have revealed blind spots on our planetary profile. Our picture of Hoxxes IV was incomplete – and we’ve discovered a biome that precisely matches those early descriptions of the boneyard.

Advisory to all employees: Deep Rock Galactic is currently preparing all departments to initiate mining operations in this new biome, officially identified as the [b]Ossuary Depths[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/4eb1353b0b8b28555d74ef9d3c846b30bd50c32e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/aaa082042f4acabf51a1ce79ee33c51a570b8267.png[/img]
All evidence suggests that the Ossuary Depths have remained virtually undisturbed for several centuries. The only proof that there once was life down here is the gargantuan bones piled in the caverns, now caked in centuries of dust. It’s quiet as the grave, more catacomb than cave. 

But you’re not alone down here. You’ll be venturing into the home of the Ossirans, a species who thrive on collecting the countless bones that give the Ossuary Depths its name. Tectonic tremors caused by our Core-level operations appear to have disturbed the Ossirians. They’ve begun burrowing beyond their native Depths, tunneling into the rest of Hoxxes and bringing all the planet’s terrors into their once-lonely mausoleum.

Perhaps Management was right to stay away from this place.


[h3][b]NEW ENEMIES: Ossiran Scrab & Ossiran Pit Jaw[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/0771fbfd47f78f3da7a5739acc6cc3faf8ebabca.png[/img]
In addition to the usual host of enemies, mining operations in the Ossuary Depths will bring you up against a couple of nasty new specimens.

[h3]1. Ossiran Scrab[/h3]
These scavenger drones are the ones stripping the meat off the bones of Ossuary Depths – but if disturbed from their work, they’ll gladly flay a dwarf too. What they might lack in size, they make up for in numbers. They tend to congregate in hive clusters.

[h3]2. Ossiran Pit Jaw[/h3]
A larger, deadlier, more patient cousin of the Scrab. It’s a burrower, preferring to ambush prey with its massive four-pronged jaw. If you’re lucky, you might just see its jaws poking through the dirt before it’s too late. Early analyses from R&D described it as [i]“A living bear trap”[/i] and [i]“Like a cave leech in the floor.”[/i]

Watch your step.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/afe85c692c8a84c7c7f1615917f47894499645fa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/9aed5f07ebbb522853082ef6f4fa79aba4ddf565.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]NEW MISSION: Heavy Excavation[/b][/h3]

Season 06 also introduces a new primary mission objective, available in the Ossuary Depths and every other biome of Hoxxes IV.

A recent spike in tectonic tremors (completely unrelated to extensive Drillevator use during Deep Scan operations) has had unexpected consequences for our priorities here on Hoxxes. For one, these tremors appear to have disturbed the residents of the Ossuary Depths, causing hazardous complications for our operational profit margins. But they've also pushed invaluable deposits of Resinite Mass closer to the surface, giving us a lucrative new target for extraction.

In other words, you're going amber hunting. R&D expects these fossilized relics may give us a sharper understanding of natural life on Hoxxes, and the evolutionary origins of the Glyphids. Failing that, we can probably sell them for a fortune on the outer rim mineral market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/3fd15c4e1e33af03bd47f831de9ae7506a820de5.jpg[/img]
You’ll need to locate and excavate deposits of this fossilized treasure, and you can expect to find several deposits in each mission. Once you've found some, it's time to prepare the dig site.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/3445e85ddb098b9a3b0bab44e2cb1b6bfec4daf8.jpg[/img]
When you've excavated around the Resinite Deposit, Mission Control will send down a supply pod equipped with four lift thrusters, which you'll need to fasten to the sides of the crystal. Once that's done, you just stand back and enjoy the light show while the thrusters laser-carve their way up to orbital extraction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/c2abaa94a00ea402af1801c36959d7ddd9ce9b1d.jpg[/img]
This new primary objective is set to be one of our more straightforward mission formats, a callback to the OGs like Mining Expedition and Egg Hunt. And, as a fun fact, the mission concept is almost as old as DRG itself. Some of the earliest recorded voicelines reference "calling down the thruster pods" for this mission.


[h3][b]NEW SEASON EVENT: Ossium Raid[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/fc8c66913efa3c068fac2568a95b24fdf9bd6b9e.jpg[/img]
The season event introduces the third Ossian enemy to appear on Hoxxes: The [b]Bone Collector[/b], a sort of insectoid prospector now liable to be found in any biome of Hoxxes. This passive creature will not attack on contact, focused instead on collecting remains for eventual storage in the Ossuary Depths. You’ll need to locate it and chase it down into the labyrinthian burrows where it hides its precious harvest.

Inside, you’ll need to locate the real treasure, which is a cache of crystallized Ossium. Management wants you to collect as much as you can – but don’t expect the Ossians to let it go without a fight.


[h3][b]NEW PERFORMANCE PASS[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/adeb05a8317f6d4ac6e66c674cc1cb2c0d14b181.jpg[/img]
It wouldn't be a new season without a new Performance Pass. We'll be introducing another full tree of unlockable hats, facial hair, resources, and of course the season's new Weapon Framework: [b]Diesel Driven.[/b]

This cache of antiquated company equipment has been sitting in storage for decades, still packed in the greasy wax paper from the factory. Waste not, want not, says Management – it’s now been approved for operational use.


[h3][b]...and more to come![/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New victory moves
[*] New dances
[*] New pickaxe set
[*] New DLC armor set
[*] QoL tweaks?
[*] Other cool stuff
[/list]
Season 06 is currently set to release in Q1 of 2026, before Rogue Core launches to Early Access. Keep an eye on the Deep Rock Galactic Steam page for teasers and updates in the months to come.

All Season 06 content will be completely free as always, except for the DLC armor set. Quality feed for the office horse isn't cheap, you know.


[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Rogue Core's Early Access release has been pushed back a couple months.[/b][/h2]

Just like the headline says, we’ve decided to delay Rogue Core’s early access release a little bit.

It’s coming along nicely, but we think it needs a few more minutes in the oven. We’d rather push our deadlines than feel rushed or crunched to get it out. This way, we’ll have time to feel like we can give it everything it deserves for early access.

Our current aim is for early access launch in Q2 2026.

So what’s going to happen in the months until then? Our answer for now is whatever needs doing. We’ll be spending this time implementing more features and tightening everything up, but the specifics of exactly what we’ll focus on are hard to say. It’ll depend on feedback and data from our playtests, internal discussions, and good ol’ gut feelings.

[previewyoutube=BA5pC7upUnw;full][/previewyoutube]
In the Rogue Core segment above you can catch a walkthrough of some of the new features we're recently added. And we’ve also made an updated road map from now through Q2 2026, just to lay out a couple milestones. We’ll keep you updated along the way with anything especially important or interesting as it comes up.

Here's the new road map:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/1abbc04a153d26a0eff7352aea27a3d06edb7f57.jpg[/img]

If you'd like to get updates on Rogue Core's development over the coming months, you can head over to the Steam store page and click the 'Follow' button.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is now out on mobile.[/b][/h2]

This is just a quick one, as most of our stream focused on DRG and Rogue Core. But ever since Funday Games launched the bullet-heaven DRG spinoff in Early Access in February 2024, [i]“Bring it to mobile”[/i] was the number one fan request. Well, now it's here!

The mobile port of Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor just launched yesterday, and you can snag it via [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ghostshippublishing.deeprockgalacticsurvivor]Google Play[/url] as well as the [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/deep-rock-galactic-survivor/id6742194903]Apple App Store[/url].

It’s the same game as always, but now it's easier to play on the toilet! 
Check out the release trailer.

[previewyoutube=UE9eDeD1eDQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
That'll do it for now. What do you think? Let us know down below.
Hope everyone's doing well, and looking forward to sharing more Season 06 as soon as we can. :)

[b]Rock and Stone forever![/b]

[i]With love,
- The Ghost Ship Crew[/i]

newsitems.title: Deep Rock Galactic unearths its season 6 update as Rogue Core spinoff gets delayed
newsitems.contents:
"Season...6..." I gasp through a parched throat and unwashed beard. "Need...season 6...of popular subterranean co-op shooter Deep Rock Galactic, developed by Ghost Ship Games..."

Mr. Ghost Ship himself stands over my skeletal body, knees and elbows shredded to the sinew from nearly a year and a half of crawling through the update desert. "How about Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor’s recent 1.0 release, or our upcoming, if sadly delayed, roguelike spin-off Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core?"

"I mean...they’re alright," I croak. "But season...siiiiiiiiiix..."

"Okay, okay," he concedes. "It’s called Relics of Hoxxes and it’s out in Q1 2026, which in English is between January and March."

"Ah...nice."

newsitems.contents:

[h3]DRG: Survivor 1.0 is out today[/h3]

Speaking of mining, we got quotas to fill. That's why another mining initiative is now available.  
[b]Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor[/b] launches into 1.0 TODAY! Grab your pickaxe and head this way:

[/p][p]ROCK AND STONE!!

[i]With Love, 
-The Ghost Ship Crew[/i]


[/p]

[h1]Hello Miners,[/h1]

In space, there are no vacations. But when you work for a company like Deep Rock Galactic, the work is so fulfilling that you nearly forget you were even wondering why the contract didn’t say anything about time off in the first place.

Speaking of terrific mandatory work events, it’s almost time for the [b]Space Beach Party[/b] seasonal event in Deep Rock Galactic! The party starts [b]Thursday, July 31st[/b] at [b]13:00 CEST[/b] and runs for two weeks.

Here’s what’s coming:
[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/6b1d439ec231ed54d304e521f5944461dadf9a17.png[/img]
[h2]The hat you have to work for[/h2]

The best hats must be earned by the sweat of your own brow. Then you can put it on and absorb more brow sweat while you continue working, because that Bismor’s not gonna mine itself. 

This Space Beach Party, you can earn the new [b]Swim Instructor[/b] hat! Just complete the associated assignment in the Mission Terminal and it’s all yours.

[h2]Summery hats from years past[/h2]

In case you are a new employee at Deep Rock Galactic, or you avoided your work responsibilities last summer, you’ve got [b]old editions of Space Beach Party hats[/b] to collect.

Management has gracefully dug up some surplus stock for you to collect. Not for free, of course. Just one work assignment, and all previous Space Beach Party hats will be permanently added to your inventory.

[h2]Another pool floaty fiasco[/h2]

Every other interplanetary courier firm was off on vacation, so the Deep Rock Galactic corporation was once again forced to enlist the services of Longbeard Freight to manage a priceless shipment of inflatable pool toys.

Unfortunately, in what many are already calling “the bummer of the summer,” those bunglers at Longbeard have once again crashed their freighter and lost the entire load of pool floaties throughout the caves of Hoxxes.

We need your help. During each mission, we’ll need you to locate and deposit a lost pool floaty toy. If you can help, Management will reward you and your whole team with a [b]Double Performance Pass Point Bonus[/b].

[h2]Sensational Space Rig decorations[/h2]

Of course, it wouldn’t be a proper Space Beach Party without [b]festive decorations[/b]. When the event starts, you’ll find the Space Rig fully decked out with tropical palm leaves, beach inflatables, water balloons and paper luau lanterns. We’ve even created a miniature beach at the Abyss Bar by dumping a mixture of sand and boron on the dance floor! Employees are encouraged to not stand on this mixture for more than 90 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/964b81b9d43e7c447723aab10306a6820316ac6f.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
The 2025 Space Beach Party starts on [b]July 31st[/b] at [b]13:00 CEST[/b]. SPF 50+ recommended.

See you soon!

[i]Cowabunga,
-The Ghost Ship Crew[/i]

newsitems.contents: There's a term in tabletop gaming: "beer and pretzels." It's an epithet you'll find tacked on to any game best played with unserious intentions and inebriants aplenty. newsitems.title: The Great Egg Hunt Preview
newsitems.author: GSG_Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/5a8f309bea9ac9dd8df98e4a606a18eeee35fe4f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello Miners,[/h2]

The eggs are back. There are dozens of them. Hundreds, even.

At a time when the world is more focused on eggs than ever before, we thought it would be apt to bring back the ultimate in egg-centric celebrations: [b]The Great Egg Hunt.
[/b]
That’s right, eggheads. The Great Egg Hunt is coming back to Deep Rock Galactic on [b]Thursday, April 10th[/b], and it’s bringing a veritable eggload of goodies and professional development opportunities along with it.

It’s time to count our eggs before they hatch. Here’s a preview of what’s coming – and if you’re interested, there’s some Rogue Core news down at the bottom.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]A new hat for your health and pleasure[/h3]

You can’t spell The Great Egg Hunt without “hats!” 

Well you can, but it wouldn’t make a very good segue to talk about hats. Speaking of hats, we’ve got a new one for you. The college kids down in R&D have spent the past year pushing the envelope of noggin-covering technology, and their proud result is the [b]Winged Buckaroo[/b].

Want it? You’ll have to work for it. We’re a mining company, not a hat charity. You can earn it via the [b]Great Egg Hunt[/b] assignment in the Mission Terminal.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/38254e7bf5d6a373420ee8b05b93a1d4cc7115c8.png[/img]

[h3]Historic hats of Egg Hunts past[/h3]

Celebrating The Great Egg Hunt with just a single hat would be like making an omelet with a single egg. Ridiculous! Only a child would be satisfied.

Fret not, miners. Management, in their boundless generosity, has approved the release of a cache of headwear from previous Egg Hunt celebrations. If you forgot to collect these earlier editions, now’s your chance! Complete the [b]Last Year’s Spring Fashion[/b] assignment and you’ll get all of them forever.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/d5dac05efce710aede62fa175e95f305dd2a635d.png[/img]

[h3]Wanted: Adorable bunnies, dead or alive[/h3]

Despite their track record, Management decided to once again entrust a load of [b]Mechanical Spring Bunnies[/b] to the infamous Longbeard Freight Company. But to our great dismay and surprise, those buffoons have biffed the job once again! Another Longbeard vessel has been lost with all hands over Hoxxes, and its payload is now scattered throughout the caves.

These confounded rabbit toys are making a horrible racket, and it’s disrupting our Deep Scan activities. If you see one while down in the caves, shoot its lights out and deposit it in the M.U.L.E. to earn a [b]Double Performance Pass Bonus[/b] for your whole team.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/b3136f9ba00511dfe6614e8fd403f8e86f1b1bb0.png[/img]
[h3]The Space Rig has been egged[/h3]

If you thought last year’s egg budget was excessive, you wouldn’t believe what this year’s seasonal decorations cost the company. Management has forked over a small fortune to deck out Space Rig 17 with lovely pastel lights, adorable bunny garlands, inflatable carrots and a bounty of decorative eggs. As always, the eggs are to be appreciated from a safe distance.

While the eggs have been unusually expensive this year, please don’t be concerned that these eggshorbitant eggspenditures are cutting into Company profits. Management has wisely found room in the annual budget by eliminating wasteful spending on laundry, cleaning and sterilization services in the Medical Bay.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]News from the Rogue Core desk[/h3]

There’s been a couple things happening over at Rogue Core Ranch.

First, we’ve got a new Rogue Core trailer coming next week! We’re premiering it on [b]April 10th at 18:00 CEST[/b] as part of the Triple-I initiative. You can tune in to watch the live reveal on Youtube and Twitch. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/]More on all that here[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2605790/view/534345486851637807?l=english

And earlier this week, on April 1st of all days, we put out a goofy Rogue Core video. If you love to smile and laugh and have fun, you can watch it here:

[previewyoutube=Fk_oE3OFVp8;full][/previewyoutube]
But wait, there’s more! There’s also [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2605790/view/534345939582715197?l=english]a new Below Decks behind-the-scenes article[/url], which explores the design process behind the Reclaimer gauntlets you see in the video. Give it a read if you’ve got the time and interest.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2605790/view/534345939582715197?l=english

[hr][/hr]
That's it for now! See you all next week to offer you an egg in this trying time. 
Once again, The Great Egg Hunt starts on April 10th at 13:00 CEST, and it'll run for two weeks.

Hope everybody's doing well -- Rock and Stone.

[i]With eggs,
-The Ghost Ship Crew
[/i]

newsitems.title: ‘Seven Years in Orbit’ anniversary event preview
newsitems.author: GSG_Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/7bc8d56dede0562c4254aabf6c3fb7e907e4b768.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello Miners,[/h2]

It’s nearly time to celebrate another year in orbit! 

Deep Rock Galactic turns seven years old this month. It’s been a heck of a ride so far – we couldn’t be more proud of the millions of tons of minerals extracted from Hoxxes and the hard-working dwarves that make it happen.

To recognize your invaluable efforts, we’re throwing a party! The [b]‘Seven Years in Orbit’[/b] Celebration is going live in-game next week, on [b]Thursday, February 27th at 13:00 CET[/b]. It’ll run for two weeks, after which all mining operations are expected to resume their usual tempo.

Here’s a preview of this year’s festivities.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Introducing the Skullcrusher Armor DLC[/h3]

[previewyoutube=CiP_1dA_xq0;full][/previewyoutube]
First up: There’s a new DLC armor set coming to town.

The Skullcrusher set brings you the ancestral armor of the Skullcrusher clan. They may be best known for brewing ale, but they bear the name for good reason. It’s said this ancestral armor still echoes with the call of the war horn – and yearns to be worn into battle once more.

You can find more details and wishlist this DLC below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481460/Deep_Rock_Galactic__Skullcrusher_Pack/

[h3]Exclusive hat alert[/h3]

There’s no better way to celebrate all your hard work than more hard work! That’s what the latest DRG Employee Engagement Manual says, anyway. So to make this a proper party, we’re introducing the [b]Party Hat - Year Seven[/b] headgear. This is a rare case of a time-limited hat – so if you don’t earn it by completing the associated Assignment, the opportunity disappears forever once this event ends. Get to it, miners!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/c923c74e7158159c6336e01ea464df99d3818e03.png[/img]
[h3]Double XP on the job[/h3]

Like all proper events, this one comes with a [b]Double Performance Pass Bonus[/b]! While you’re down in the mines, keep an eye on your Terrain Scanner to find a hidden Year 7 Anniversary Trophy buried in the dirt. Dig it out, deposit it, and the rewarding nature of this experience will result in you coming home with double XP earned from the mission.

[h3]Free beer for all (Management begs you to drink responsibly)[/h3]

A few weeks ago when we published [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/548430/view/688590523596800024?l=english]last year’s workforce statistics[/url], Management was very pleased to note that there was an overall decline in employees passing out on the job due to alcohol consumption.

Confident that the DRG workforce has learned its lesson about the detrimental effects of alcohol, Management has agreed to provide free beer at the Abyss Bar during these celebrations. You’ll be able to drink Oily Oaf Brew, Glyphid Slammer and Leaf Lover’s Special to your heart’s content! Cheers, miners.

[h3]The Space Rig’s looking sharp[/h3]

As with all anniversary celebrations, we’ll be dressing up the Space Rig like a five-star hotel! The gilded marble dance floor returns, along with tinsel and confetti, balloons, and precious chandeliers. 

Management expresses their sincere hope that these elegant decorations inspire you to work even harder in the coming year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/b69753cbd0727ae809cdb977df941cbb26ffc93d.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]‘Seven Years in Orbit’ celebratory developer livestream[/h3]

Every year, we also mark DRG’s birthday with a special livestream from the GSG crew. And you guessed it – we’re doing it again! We hope you’ll join us right after the event launches on [b]February 27th at 14:00 CET[/b] for a cozy livestream from us to you.

Some years are bigger than others – and to manage expectations, we’re not gonna be revealing anything groundbreaking here. But we will have some special guests, and we’ll going live to reminisce on the years that have gone by, the path ahead, and of course to answer questions from you lovely folk.

So again, that’s Thursday, February 27th at 14:00 CET for the dev stream. Hope you can join us!

[i]With love,
-The Ghost Ship Crew[/i]

newsitems.title: Lunar Festival 2025 Preview
newsitems.author: GSG_Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/1e93eb04bf87ab092e80150f25bd7684378e0380.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello Miners,[/h2]

According to the lunar calendar, a new year is nearly upon us! If you ask Management, though, you should quit worrying about what the moon is doing, and focus on your own work in the mines.

However, as tradition dictates, it’s nearly time for another Lunar Festival in Deep Rock Galactic! We’re just about ready to get the Year of the Snake off to a slithering start.

This year’s Lunar Festival goes live on [b]Thursday, January 30th at 13:00 CET[/b], and it’ll run until February 13th.

Let’s take a look at what’s in store:

[hr][/hr]
[h3]There’s a snake on my head![/h3]

To motivate our workforce during these celebrations, Management has seen fit to commission yet another piece of festive headgear. Starting next week, all employees will have the opportunity to earn [b]The Serpentine Special[/b] – simply complete the Lunar Festival 2025 assignment, and you’ll unlock this slithery specimen for all classes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/dd674f4125dafb28386f88f1d369ad904ed0d385.png[/img]

[h3]Snag the hats from previous Lunar Festivals[/h3]

During an asbestos recycling operation on one of our orbital storage facilities, we stumbled across an old cache of hats from previous Lunar Festival events. While interplanetary hazmat protocols dictate we incinerate these hats, Management has generously decided to offer them up to our employees instead!

To collect all these old hats in one fell swoop, just complete the [b]Last Year's Blessings[/b] assignment and we’ll add them all to your inventory. And if you notice any chest pains while wearing these hats, keep it to yourself.

[h3]Snakes in a Cave[/h3]

It started as a route transport job for Longbeard Freight. But a shipment of rare venomous snakes got loose from the cargo hold and attacked the pilot, tragically causing the vessel to crash on Hoxxes with a loss of all crew and passengers. 

Even more tragic, though, is that the doomed freighter was also carrying a load of antique Golden Serpent statues that Management had ordered. Now these statues are scattered through the caves of Hoxxes – and to make matters worse, our insurance policy doesn’t cover snake-based accidents.

We need your help. Dig up and deposit a Golden Serpent statue during your mission, and Management will reward your whole team with a [b]Double Performance Point Bonus[/b]. Everyone wins.

[h3]Firecrackers are back on the menu[/h3]

We’ve got the Space Rig looking dazzling with festive banners, lovely paper lanterns, and a fresh shipment of Space Persimmons. And much to the chagrin of Management, complementary firecrackers will make a return during the Festival.

Management initially decided to stop with the firecrackers due to employees’ reckless conduct last year. However, a large shipment of mining explosives turned out to be too unstable to use in subsurface operations, so we decided to turn lemons into lemonade. Try not to use them near the windows.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Join the GUNTOUCHABLES Closed Alpha playtest [/h3]

Oh, on another note – GUNTOUCHABLES, which is coming out via Ghost Ship Publishing, is holding a Closed Alpha Playtest next week. If you’re interested, we’d like to invite you to sign up! You can do so on their Steam store page.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2543510/view/501689139151765525?l=english

That’s all for now! Let us know in the comments if you think Steeve would wear one pair of jeans with 8 legs, or four pairs of regular jeans.

[i]With love,
-The Ghost Ship Crew[/i]

newsitems.title: Yuletide 2024 preview
newsitems.author: GSG_Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/e2c7a6684cbd490f31012074b1b1816c8aa15641.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello Miners,[/h2]

The holidays are nearly here! 

We mean that in a figurative sense, of course. Management would like to clarify that the term "holiday" should not be in any way associated with paid time off. Here at Deep Rock Galactic, we like to think of holidays as a sort of special flavor that motivates our employees to work even harder. And it's almost time for the year's coziest, most motivating holiday: [b]Yuletide![/b]

The Yuletide 2024 seasonal event starts on [b]Thursday, December 19th[/b] at [b]13:00 CET[/b]. It'll run until January 7th 2025, which is a little longer than standard seasonal events, so you’ve got some extra time to gather up all your Yuletide goodies.

Let’s give the present a little shake and guess what’s inside.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Your yearly Yuletide gift from Management[/h3]
It’s been a terrific year for the company, so we’ve decided to give each and every employee your own special Yuletide gift. At long last, we’ve invested in better equipment! We’ve requisitioned some advanced, highly functional safety gear for all of you: the [b]Gift Wrapped[/b] hat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/60c90aeb22a574eb65f4e267451dab414ab3c557.png[/img]
This sturdy cardboard helmet should protect you from the consequences of at least one workplace accident. That’s a huge improvement in the company safety record, statistically speaking.

Of course, a gift is best when you can appreciate its worth. That’s why you’ve got to work for it! You can unlock the Gift Wrapped helmet via the [b]Yearly Performance Bonus[/b] assignment, which will also grant you extra Performance Points, crafting resources, credits and a couple infused Matrix Cores. 
Don’t say we never did anything for you! 


[h3]Open season on Yuletide Elves[/h3]
It seems that we’re dealing with another seasonal infestation of Yuletide Elves. If left to run wild through the caves of Hoxxes, they’re liable to get caught and ground up in our mining equipment, and that’d have an unacceptable consequence for our productivity. To prevent that, we’re tasking you with a simple solution: Bag ‘em and tag ‘em.

Shoot the Elves on sight, deposit the body in the M.U.L.E., and Management will grant you (and your team) a [b]Double Mission Performance Point Bonus[/b].


[h3]Collect all the hats of Yuletide past[/h3]
Just like always, you’ll be able to snag the whole run of old Yuletide hats, all in one fell swoop. They’re a bit dusty, but if you’re willing to sweat for ‘em, they’re yours.

Complete the [b]Fashion of Yuletide Past[/b] assignment to unlock all the Yuletide cosmetics from past years’ celebrations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/f5e8898a3f78097eba57c596fc8fcaf4336dc385.jpg[/img]

[h3]A few extra goodies under the tree[/h3]
But wait, there’s more! Complete the [b]Yuletide Elf Hunt[/b] assignment, and you’ll unlock the following:
[list]
[*] Pickaxe set: ‘Chillaxe’
[*] Bosco framework: ‘Yuletide Special’
[*] Elf suit armor + headwear*
[/list]This assignment will only appear for you if you haven’t already completed it and collected the rewards a previous year.

[i]*Last year, Management documented a significant number of friendly fire incidents connected to wearing this elf costume. We reiterate once again that all injuries sustained while wearing this outfit are the employee’s individual responsibility.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/bce8b77b9cfb253bc88661c1e0afdee227a67fac.jpg[/img]

[h3]Deck the Halls With Balls of Gunk Seed[/h3]
To complete the Yuletide experience, Management has once again decorated the Space Rig for the holidays. Your break time is still unpaid, but now it’s much more festive! You can look forward to holiday garlands, delicate ornaments, cheery Yuletide music, colorful lights, and all the rest! We plugged the holiday lights into the same outlet we use for the life support systems in the Med Bay, so don’t go fiddling with it.

Management would like to underline that these decorations are provided on the assumption that all employees will respect the [u]No Snowball Throwing[/u] policy while aboard the Space Rig. You’re here to work, not to feel Yuletide joy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/0e7012b53506ba9723d9c478d4b60932a0ce5e02.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Yuletide 2024 begins on [b]Thursday, December 19th at 13:00 CET[/b] and it’ll run until Tuesday, January 7th at 13:00 CET.

Bundle up, Miners!
[i]With love,
-The Ghost Ship Crew[/i]

newsitems.title: On the Horizon Recap: November 2024
newsitems.author: GSG_Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[previewyoutube=SZdq9fLe7yM;full][/previewyoutube][i]Broadcast starts at the 6:03 timestamp[/i]

[h2]Hello Miners,[/h2]

In case you missed our big ‘On the Horizon’ dev livestream last Thursday, we’ve got a whole lot of news to share! You can watch the whole thing right up above, but we’ve also got the highlights down below.

[h3]The tippy-top highlights[/h3]

If you’ve just got two minutes, here’s what you should know:
[list]
[*] [b][u]Deep Rock Galactic merch is finally here![/u][/b] We teamed up with Heroic Replicas to open the official [url=http://www.deeprockshop.com]DRG merch webshop[/url] – and, in collaboration with Scorched Steel Industry, we’ll soon be releasing official [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/745810196/deep-rock-galactic-high-quality-mugs-50cl]Abyss Bar beer mugs[/url] via Kickstarter.
[*] [b][u]The first Rogue Core teaser trailer is out.[/u][/b] We also went into Unreal Engine to showcase some of the enemies and weapons, and discussed a lot of details about the state of gameplay. [url=https://youtu.be/VXnK8YrWdA0?si=9JeaAHE629jFdwiH]Click here to watch the teaser[/url], or scroll down for the full segment and more details.
[*] [b][u]Rogue Core's Closed Alpha is slated for Q2 2025, and an Early Access release at the end of 2025.[/u][/b] For more updates on the game’s development (and potential Closed Alpha access), [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/]follow Rogue Core on Steam[/url].
[*] [b][u]Deep Rock Galactic Season 06 will have to wait until Rogue Core is out in Early Access.[/u][/b] We’re tackling one big project at a time, so we’re holding off on planning or developing anything to do with Season 06 while we’re going full steam ahead on Rogue Core.
[*] [b][u]Ghost Ship Publishing has announced a new title: Guntouchables.[/u][/b] Developed by the Danish studio GameSwing, we’re psyched to help bring another fun co-op shooter into the world. [url=https://youtu.be/spRsBqX1Cag]See the reveal trailer here[/url].
[/list]Below, we've got an updated roadmap (covering all of Ghost Ship Games and Publishing) for you. Then we'll go through the broadcast segment by segment, to sum up the most important bits. 

[i][b]EDIT [Nov. 29][/b] - Apparently some of the embedded video links were busted. We don't know why (suspected Rival interference?) but it should be fixed now[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/a22511d985b60f530f91b689b8357f1530d3fdff.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Take a tour of Ghost Ship Games' new office[/h2]

After our big move in August, we’ve now gotten (mostly) settled in the new digs! Here’s Aaron to give you an engaging and educational six-minute tour of our new workspace. 

[previewyoutube=L1LzygOXKbg;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Deep Rock Galactic merch is finally here![/h2]

[previewyoutube=ZsNWscVaYsg;full][/previewyoutube]
Finally, the days of [i]“DRG has no merch”[/i] are over. Thanks to our friend Dave at Heroic Replicas, the [b]official Deep Rock Galactic merch webshop[/b] is live!

You can [url=http://www.deeprockshop.com]check out the webshop[/url] right this red-hot minute. It’s got loads of cool stuff, such as:
[list]
[*] T-shirts for all four classes (duh, gotta have t-shirts)
[*] Ceramic Loot Bug piggy banks (buggy banks?)
[*] A dedicated light-up RGB mechanical keyboard that’s literally just the ‘V’ button so you can Rock and Stone more easily
[/list]And much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27142043/6370c215931e004a3b7f0f3dd981ad8a6c0fd87e.png[/img][i]Pro tip: Use coupon code 'COUPONCODE' for a free sticker pack on any orders over $40[/i]

Everything listed here is up for pre-order now, shipping in early 2025. And it’s worth highlighting that this selection is only Phase One of the merch project – we’ll have more cool releases landing in the shop in the coming months. Stay tuned!

[b][url=http://www.deeprockshop.com]http://www.deeprockshop.com[/url][/b] 

But that’s not all! Through a collaboration with Scorched Steel Industry, we’re happy to announce that your most asked-after merch item is finally a reality. Soon, your beverage of choice will find a spectacular new home in the [b]official Abyss Bar beer mugs[/b].

[previewyoutube=dZgCkAVRU_g;full][/previewyoutube]
Scorched Steel is funding this project via Kickstarter, and the launch date for their campaign is just around the corner. If you’d like to back it and grab one (or a few) of these mugs for yourself, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/745810196/deep-rock-galactic-high-quality-mugs-50cl]click here to be notified[/url] when the Kickstarter campaign goes live.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Rogue Core: New teaser trailer and gameplay details[/h2]

[previewyoutube=3mdn9Uhea9I;full][/previewyoutube]
The first glimpses of Rogue Core are here! If you haven’t already seen it, check out the new Pre-Alpha Teaser Trailer above, or by clicking [url=https://youtu.be/VXnK8YrWdA0?si=JEuuD2MklZ8--_c0]right here[/url].

We spent the majority of On the Horizon discussing all sorts of Rogue Core details, from gameplay to enemy design to release timeline. We did a writeup of all of that, but it was so big that it became its own article – so if you’re keen for more Rogue Core, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2605790/view/4482865501645572470]you can read all about it right here[/url].

Right now, we’re aiming for a Rogue Core Closed Alpha in Q2 2025, and an Early Access release at the end of the year (Q4 2025).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Ghost Ship Publishing updates[/h2]

As always, we touched base with all the developers releasing games via Ghost Ship Publishing to hear where they’re at. If you’d like more details on each title, the Ghost Ship Publishing segment starts at the [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/SZdq9fLe7yM?feature=shared&t=1092]18:12[/url] timestamp. Otherwise, here are three bullet points from each:

[h3][b]Guntouchables[/b] (GameSwing)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Say hello to the newest title to get picked up by Ghost Ship Publishing! In this co-op roguelike arcade shooter, four doomsday preppers blast their way through the disaster they’ve all been waiting for.
[*] You can [url=https://youtu.be/spRsBqX1Cag?si=YDHt61evXa9YkfQ7]watch the Guntouchables release trailer here[/url]. GameSwing, the developers, describe the game as “Nuclear Throne meets Left 4 Dead.” Teamwork, fast feet and firepower reign supreme.
[*] Guntouchables will be releasing to Early Access on Steam in Q1 2025.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543510/GUNTOUCHABLES/


[h3][b]SpellRogue[/b] (Guidelight Games)[/h3]
[list]
[*] The SpellRogue team has been busy putting out five big updates in the 10 months since they released to Early Access. Loads more spells, QoL tweaks, enemies and difficulty modifiers have been added since launch.
[*] Next major milestone for SpellRogue is adding a fourth playable character: the Wind Wizard. They’re still refining and balancing how that new dice caster will play.
[*] For now, the team’s plan is to release SpellRogue 1.0 around March 2025.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1990110/SpellRogue/


[h3][b]Dinolords[/b] (Northplay Games)[/h3]
[list]
[*] This historically-accurate game about medieval dinosaur wars is currently experimenting with how they’ll balance gameplay between action and strategy. The team calls the genre “hack ‘n strat.”
[*] Ability to ride dinosaurs confirmed. Other recent focuses include advanced base building and resource management, and an expanded selection of dinosaurs.
[*] Dinolords is aiming to make their Early Access launch on Steam in Q3 2025.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587620/Dinolords/


[h3][b]Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor[/b] (Funday Games)[/h3]
[list]
[*] When we called them up during the stream, the Funday Team was in London to represent DRG: Survivor at the Golden Joystick Awards. They didn’t end up taking home the W, but we’re proud of them all the same. <3
[*] We did a little recap of the recent [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/S1gZi_6AX2M?si=2cKPobcK9KrsNKOI]Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Ultimate Challenge Invitationals[/url] broadcast, the most important sporting event in history.
[*] Funday Games is planning Update 5 for DRG: Survivor somewhere in Q1 2025. They’ve said their 1.0 release is still TBA.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2321470/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Survivor/
